outputText: Subject: A large, green, grotesque head with pointed ears and orange eyes, rooted to the floor with numerous vine-like tendrils extending outward; the head is expelling a long scroll of paper from its mouth. Framing: Centered, eye-level shot focusing on the head and the scroll, with the tendrils spreading symmetrically around it; background elements are blurred but visible. Lighting: Even, diffuse overhead lighting casting soft shadows beneath the head and tendrils; light source primarily from above and slightly front. Visible transformation: The head appears animated by the scroll emerging from its mouth, suggesting an ongoing expulsion or expression; no physical change in the head itself. Continuity: Maintain the central placement of the head and the sprawling tendrils on the floor; the scroll should remain partially extended, emphasizing the act of release; lighting should stay consistent with overhead diffuse illumination to preserve the industrial atmosphere.
